'''Taylor Akinsson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[February 2000 Montreal tournament]] on 20 February 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HD/sac/Big Blue/mains and toys with Crush The Rebellion]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ montreal-quebec-02-20-2000], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 21 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
